policy: The DE*VIR prefix is a shared Virta technical/network prefix and must not receive a national fallback tariff. Rank these prices only for exact friesenenergie station/EVSE matches. friesenenergie officially publishes 0.64 EUR/kWh for one-time card payment and 0.49 EUR/kWh via Virta app/RFID for its own public charging points; roaming prices from third-party cards/apps are excluded.
